ORIGINAL VERSION · 4–8 MINUTE SOLO ADVENTURE
Walk a day that refuses to repeat.

You have three visits before the thirteenth bell—unless Fracture reaches 4 and catastrophe arrives early. Predict scheduled events to gain Momentum, then carry one bond and one object through midnight. Scars never reset.

1 · Predict
Commit before the next bell.
2 · Travel & act
Every choice strains the town.
3 · Spend Momentum
Skip scenes you have mastered.
4 · Anchor
Choose what tomorrow remembers.
